== Notes ==
* Similarly to [[Mantra of Resolve]] or [[Pious Concentration]], Distortion will trigger and allow to block once then end if the user can't afford the energy cost. 
* Consider combining with [[Spirit of Failure]].

==Trivia==
*Prior to the release of [[Guild Wars Prophecies]] this skill was called "Mantra of Diversion".
